items.t: SOLV Q3 2026 deep dive: ERP transition, separation milestones, and margin focus define quarter
items.sum: Healthcare solutions provider Solventum (NYSE:SOLV) reported Q3 2026 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, but sales fell by 7% year on year to $1.95 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.45 per share was 7.9% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.sum: Shares of healthcare solutions provider Solventum (NYSE:SOLV) jumped 5% in the afternoon session after the company reported third-quarter 2026 financial results and raised its full-year adjusted earnings per share guidance.

items.t: What Is Solventum (SOLV) Signaling With Its 90% Separation And HIS Split Plan?
items.sum: Solventum (NYSE:SOLV) reports that more than 90% of its separation from former parent 3M is now complete. The healthcare supplier has executed its largest ever ERP cutover, consolidating core systems into a new standalone platform.
